summary: Sun Life Financial filed a 6-K reporting results of the conversion privilege for its Class A Non-Cumulative Rate Reset Preferred Shares Series 10R and Floating Rate Preferred Shares Series 11QR, effective September 30, 2026. Only 1,400 Series 10R and 621,829 Series 11QR shares were elected for conversion by the September 16 deadline. Because fewer than 1,000,000 Series 11QR shares would remain, Sun Life will automatically convert all remaining Series 11QR shares into Series 10R, leaving 8,000,000 Series 10R shares and nil Series 11QR shares outstanding. This is a routine capital-structure maintenance event, not a special situation; the new 5.519% dividend rate and $25.00 optional redemption price are the only terms.
